Dumraon Raj of Bihar
The Ujjaini Rajputs of the Parmar dynasty, after losing Malwa to Alauddin Khalji, settled in present-day western Bihar, naming their new territory Bhojpur after Raja Bhoj.
In the 16th century, the Ujjainia clan, including Gajpati Ujjainia, supported Sher Shah Suri, leading to Gajpati's enthronement in Bhojpur.
The 17th century saw Jagdishpur become the new capital under Raja Narayan Mal, a friend of Prince Khurram (later Shah Jahan), and the future home of Kunwar Singh.
